<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of 192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12.5 % M+1) indicates about 11–12 carbons. The formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂ matches the exact mass (192.104 Da, error < 3 ppm) and is consistent with the observed isotopic intensity, making it the best candidate. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₂H₁₆O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
